items.a: It depends on the level — group programming, sims and 1:1 are priced differently. Everything's laid out on the coaching page, and George reviews every application personally.

items.q: I've never done HYROX — can I join?
items.a: Yes — that's most people who sign up. George builds you up from base fitness: technique on the stations first, then race-pace work. Nobody starts as a racer.

8km of running split by 8 workout stations — SkiErg, sled push, sled pull, burpee broad jumps, rowing, farmers carry, sandbag lunges and wall balls. Same format worldwide, so your time compares globally.
Sheffield-based — exact location and session times go out with the cohort announcements. Leave your email and you'll get the details directly.
Confirmed dates are on the race planner and events pages — updated the day HYROX announces them. Join the list and race-weekend plans land in your inbox.

items.q: How do I join a sim day?
items.a: Sim days get announced on the events page and to the email list first — they fill fast. Leave your email here and you'll hear before public announcement.

items.q: Can you find me a doubles partner?
items.a: That's literally what the find-a-partner page is for — post your target division and pace, and George's community matches people up. Free to use.

items.q: Do you programme for races abroad?
items.a: Yes — remote programming works for any race on the calendar. Athletes have raced Birmingham, Warsaw, Glasgow and beyond on George's plans.
Leave your email and goal here, or apply direct through the coaching page. George replies personally — usually within a day or two.
